name: Parrot: Learn Spanish Language
description:
LEARN SPANISH BY WATCHING REAL SHORT VIDEOS

Parrot teaches you Spanish the way you actually pick up a language: by watching real people speak it. Scroll a feed of short videos from native speakers, tap any word or phrase in the captions to see what it means, save it, then practice it until it sticks. No textbook Spanish – the vocabulary, pronunciation and slang people really use.

Starting from zero, or studied for years and still freeze in a real conversation? Parrot meets you at your level and builds from there.

HOW PARROT WORKS

► Scroll real videos – Short, authentic clips from native speakers, matched to your level.
► Tap to translate – Tap any word or phrase in the captions for an instant translation, then save it to your personal dictionary.
► Practice what you just watched – Quick activities after every video: match the words, fill in the blank, build the sentence, and say it out loud with instant feedback on your pronunciation.
► Review with flashcards – Your saved words and phrases come back until you know them.
► Follow your own path – A personalized learning path that adapts as your vocabulary and listening comprehension grow.
► Build the habit – Streaks, badges and challenges keep you going a few minutes at a time. You can even import your streak from other apps.
► Every milestone plants a tree.

WHICH LEVEL IS PARROT FOR?

► Complete beginners – Start with beginner videos and the most common words and phrases, and understand real Spanish from your first week.

•  3 min > 30 min

We believe that 3 minutes of actual speaking will help you more than 30 minutes watching someone else speak (long lecture videos).
Why waste your precious time learning about a language when you can learn by speaking it yourself? Our interactive lessons not only get you to speak with the tutors but gives instant feedback on your pronunciation.

• Overcome fear of speaking

Research shows that one of the greatest barriers to speaking a language is confidence. TEUIDA helps you overcome fear of speaking by simulating real-life scenarios but without all the social anxiety. (i.e. Our characters won't throw shade at you for mispronouncing!)
